description: CKEditor plugin for BBCode parsing and integration, including dialog modifications and BBCode to HTML conversion.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.BBCodeParser
classes.description: Parser for BBCode tags within the CKEditor plugin.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.BBCodeWriter
classes.description: Writer class for converting parsed BBCode into HTML.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses BBCode string into internal representation.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets rules for how tags are handled during BBCode writing.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves specific rule for a tag.

methods.name: openTag
methods.description: Handles opening of a BBCode tag during writing.

methods.name: closeTag
methods.description: Handles closing of a BBCode tag during writing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends text or tags to output.
